# Osprey

> The official website and admin-maintained wiki for the Osprey Minecraft server.

## Authoritative documentation

Use the current wiki articles for gameplay mechanics, rules, and joining information. The wiki is maintained by the Osprey admins. Follow the wiki when older summaries disagree; do not infer missing mechanics.

- [Osprey Wiki](https://osprey.build/wiki/): official documentation and page directory
- [Current wiki page index](https://osprey.build/wiki/llms.txt): automatically generated links to every published article
- [Full wiki text](https://osprey.build/wiki/llms-full.txt): current published article text, with canonical URLs
- [Wiki sitemap](https://osprey.build/wiki/sitemap-index.xml)

## Website

- [Landing page](https://osprey.build/): short introduction, map, Discord and server addresses
- [Full website](https://osprey.build/home/): server introduction, connection information and announcements
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/osprey): community and announcements
